definitions.gloss: winning a prize, placing in a competition
definitions.explanation: Finishing in a prize-winning position in a contest, competition, or tournament. Does not necessarily mean first place — any placement that earns a prize or recognition counts.

examples.japanese: コンクールで{入賞|にゅうしょう}した。
examples.english: I won a prize at the contest.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}が{絵画|かいが}コンテストで{入賞|にゅうしょう}を{果|は}たした。
examples.english: My daughter placed in the painting contest.

examples.japanese: {入賞|にゅうしょう}{者|しゃ}には{賞金|しょうきん}と{記念品|きねんひん}が{贈|おく}られる。
examples.english: Prize money and a commemorative gift will be awarded to the winners.

notes:
Covers any prize-winning placement, not just first place. Often used with specific competitions like コンクール, コンテスト, {大会|たいかい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}を{果|は}たす (achieve a prize-winning placement)
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}{者|しゃ} (prize winner)
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}{作品|さくひん} (prize-winning work)
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}を{逃|のが}す (miss out on a prize)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入賞|にゅうしょう}: placing in a competition (any prize-winning rank)
- {優勝|ゆうしょう}: winning first place, championship
- {受賞|じゅしょう}: receiving a specific named award or prize
